# Supplemental public-domain SVG stress sources

Retrieved unchanged on 2026-10-10; `cases.tsv` records SHA-256, author, license,
description page and exact download URL. SVG metadata/notices remain intact.
No brands are included. Tests never download these files. This sample covers
three world maps and two botanical/food illustrations, including Inkscape
metadata, long compound paths and gradient-heavy art. Import success and bounded
rejection are reported separately; there is no independent image-fidelity claim.

License/source pages inspected:

- Simple world map, Tom-b, CC0-1.0: [source revision](https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?title=File:Simple_world_map.svg&oldid=894322708).
- World map clip art, molumen / Openclipart, CC0-1.0: [source revision](https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?title=File:World_map_clip_art.svg&oldid=1262816527).
- BlankMap-World-Compact, Canuckguy et al., public-domain dedication: [source revision](https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?title=File:BlankMap-World-Compact.svg&oldid=1276197908).
- Orchid, Keistutis / Openclipart, CC0-1.0: [source revision](https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?title=File:Orchid.svg&oldid=737195364).
- Watermelon, James Kilfiger / Openclipart, CC0-1.0: [source revision](https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?title=File:Watermelon.svg&oldid=780337737).

[CC0-1.0 legal code](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode).
The blank map's source page publishes its author's worldwide public-domain
release and unconditional use permission where a release is not possible.
